body:
It adds Sharkium ore and much more to the game! But this world isn't as innocent as it seems.(Only Turkish Language)

THE FOLLOWING CONTAINS SPOILERS!!!!!!!!

This mod includes Sharkium ore, items, and tools, and also adds a new dimension. However, every dimension has a dark side, and it's up to you to explore this dark side and uncover the story. Good luck!
